column1: # Export names for the PE imports the Mercenaries 2 PC images (mercs2_unpacked.exe,
# genuine_patched_unpacked.exe) take by ordinal. FnMnemonicSig.java reads this table (script
# argument 3) to write an ordinal import ("Ordinal_<n>" in Ghidra) as ext:<library>!<name>.
# Source: the export directories of the 32-bit Wine builtin DLLs shipped in the Mercs2 Modkit Wine
# Each name is the export-name-table entry whose ordinal-table index plus the export directory's
# ordinal base equals <ordinal>. These DLLs are Wine's reimplementations (header marker
# "Wine builtin DLL", version resource ProductName "Wine"), not Microsoft binaries:
# Columns (tab-separated): library as Ghidra names it, ordinal (decimal), export name, sha256 of
